title: Bowl of noodles with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="bowlGrad" cx="50%" cy="40%" r="60%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#5ba8d4"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#2a6fa8"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id="noodleGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffe066"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#f0c040"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- Bowl body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="70" rx="38" ry="10" fill="#2a6fa8"/>
  <path d="M12,62 Q12,90 50,90 Q88,90 88,62 Z" fill="url(#bowlGrad)"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="62" rx="38" ry="10" fill="#4a9ad4"/>
  <!-- Inner bowl -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="62" rx="32" ry="8" fill="#1a3f6a"/>
  <!-- Broth -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="62" rx="29" ry="6.5" fill="#e8a020"/>
  <!-- Noodle squiggles -->
  <path d="M26,60 Q32,54 38,60 Q44,66 50,60 Q56,54 62,60 Q68,66 74,60" stroke="#ffe066" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M24,64 Q30,58 36,64 Q42,70 48,64 Q54,58 60,64 Q66,70 72,64 Q76,60 78,62" stroke="#ffcc33" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Egg -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="56" rx="8" ry="6" fill="#fff8e0"/>
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="56" rx="4.5" ry="3.5" fill="#ffb820"/>
  <!-- Green onion slices -->
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="55" rx="3.5" ry="2.5" fill="#6bcc4a"/>
  <ellipse cx="68" cy="58" rx="3" ry="2" fill="#5ab83a"/>
  <ellipse cx="56" cy="58" rx="2.8" ry="2" fill="#6bcc4a"/>
  <!-- Smiling face on broth area -->
  <circle cx="42" cy="67" r="2.2" fill="#ff6b6b"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="67" r="2.2" fill="#ff6b6b"/>
  <path d="M43,73 Q50,80 57,73" stroke="#ff6b6b" stroke-width="2.2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Cheek blush -->
  <ellipse cx="36" cy="72" rx="3" ry="2" fill="#ffb0b0" opacity="0.7"/>
  <ellipse cx="64" cy="72" rx="3" ry="2" fill="#ffb0b0" opacity="0.7"/>
  <!-- Chopsticks -->
  <rect x="72" y="20" width="2.5" height="42" rx="1" fill="#d4883a" transform="rotate(12 73 41)"/>
  <rect x="78" y="20" width="2.5" height="42" rx="1" fill="#c07830" transform="rotate(8 79 41)"/>
  <!-- Steam -->
  <path d="M38,42 Q35,36 38,30" stroke="#9ad0f0" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.8"/>
  <path d="M50,40 Q47,33 50,26" stroke="#9ad0f0" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.8"/>
  <path d="M62,42 Q59,36 62,30" stroke="#9ad0f0" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.8"/>
</svg>
